International Society Records

collection

The International Society originally grew out of the Chinese Economic Development Council in 1979. CEDC's mission was to improve the socio-economic conditions of Boston's Chinese community and support Chinese culture while promoting the city's understanding of that culture. This collection contains textual records and photographs, including newspaper clippings, meeting minutes, and pamphlets.
